KM★ Orders

KMEW bags ₹303.17 Cr New Mangalore Port dredging order, its largest

Three-year maintenance dredging work starts 15 November 2026; KMEW was lowest bidder but must add a mid-size trailing suction hopper dredger to execute it.

▲ Positive · High earnings impact high · market +0.2% on 1.3× volume (Fri)

KMEW₹3,095 · MCap ₹7,850 Cr · EPS ₹53.45 · PEG 4.3 · Exchange filing, read by AI · Fri 30 Oct, 12:06 PM Read ↗

Three-year maintenance dredging order at New Mangalore Port worth ₹303.17 Cr including GST, roughly ₹101.07 Cr per year.

Work starts 15 November 2026; each year's dredging must finish within 150 days.
